findings.description: Nicola Domenichelli died on 29 June 1981 in Rosario de la Frontera, Salta, Argentina; his death was registered the next day in that town's civil register, which records him as an Italian-born widower aged 84.

details.place: Rosario de la Frontera, Salta, Argentina
